clauses.text: The state requirement to allow two homes per single-family lot, and the bar on requiring a public hearing for such projects, are repealed. Each city sets the number of homes allowed on each residential lot and its own approval process.

current_law: A city must allow up to two homes on any lot zoned for single-family residential use, without a public hearing.
